key_insight: A spray distance of 190 mm produced the densest Cr3C2–NiCr coating and the best corrosion resistance on DSS 2205 in 1 M H2SO4.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing D-gun spray distance can substantially improve coating integrity and extend the service life of stainless steel components in acidic industrial environments.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Evaluated corrosion behavior in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
Compared SEM microstructure and porosity across spray distances.
evidence_signal: The 190 mm coating showed the lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), while porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm.
watch_item: Results are specific to 1 M H2SO4 and the tested spray window, so other environments or distances may not follow the same optimum.
paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
